title: Android apps froze — fixed
asked: Backfilled from CLAUDE.md Status (built before builds reported themselves).

result.summary: every Android app rendered but ignored taps. `FloatingWindowsHost` laid a full-size `Box` with a `pointerInput` over the app content to track the finger for minimize-to-cursor; a topmost sibling with any pointer input takes every touch in Compose, so nothing underneath got a tap.
